name: Crown of the Earth

angles.text: Fandral addresses you as a fellow druid. He meets the ritual's failure with curt impatience, then dismisses you.
In Darnassus, Fandral Staghelm's prickly authority meets the patient devotion of the Sisterhood of Elune at the Temple of the Moon.
Darnassus is the Alliance's chief city on Kalimdor. With Malfurion Stormrage absent, quiet tensions mark the city's leadership.

aliases: who starts crown of the earth
crown of the earth quest giver
faq.answer: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm gives you the task in Darnassus. With Malfurion Stormrage absent, Fandral oversees the Cenarion Circle. After an incantation with sacred water brings no answers, he sends you away in frustration.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Crown of the Earth?

faq.answer: You take the Drained Vessel to Priestess Lariia at the Temple of the Moon in southern Darnassus. Fandral expects the priestesses of Elune to dispose of the vessel, which he believes has no use left.
faq.q: Where do you take the Drained Vessel?

faq.answer: Fandral Staghelm bears the burden of guiding the night elves and leading the Cenarion Circle while Malfurion Stormrage is away. When his incantation yields nothing, frustration and pride make him lash out and dismiss you before examining the failure more closely.
faq.q: Why is Fandral Staghelm so frustrated?

faq.answer: Fandral believes the water had no useful power, but Priestess Lariia finds several drops still clinging inside the vessel. The rite may have failed because the vessel was not fully emptied.

Malfurion Stormrage is absent from Darnassus. Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm guides the night elves and leads the Cenarion Circle in his absence, a heavy burden that feeds Fandral's temper and impatience with setbacks.
faq.q: Where is Malfurion during this quest?

faq.answer: Priestess Lariia serves Elune at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She receives the vessel with compassion for Fandral's burdens and notices that water remains inside.

sections.body: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm guides the night elves while Malfurion Stormrage is absent. Seeking answers, he performs an incantation with sacred water held in a phial. The rite brings no answer, and Fandral's temper rises. Certain the water is useless, he dismisses you with sharp words and sends you south to the Temple of the Moon, where the priestesses can dispose of the vessel.
sections.title: Fandral's Frustration

sections.body: Priestess Lariia asks you to make allowance for Fandral's harsh manner and the burden he bears. As she examines the phial, she finds several drops of water still inside. Perhaps Fandral's magic did not fail; perhaps the vessel was never emptied.
sections.title: The Remaining Drops

summary: In Darnassus, Fandral Staghelm turns from a failed rite and sends its vessel away. He asks you to carry it to Priestess Lariia at the Temple of the Moon for disposal.
